title: FIX-AUDIT [N7]: substitute message-payload construction is still shape-exempt from the hooks lint — its gate is code-review-only
evidence:
scripts/lint_refcheck_hooks.py:24-27:
"- Call arguments (`UserChoseRefcheckAction(..., RefcheckSubstitute)`) -
  message-payload construction inside the hook-gated surface fns; the
  panel tests pin those surfaces (N7)."
scripts/lint_refcheck_hooks.py:134-135:
"            inner = stack[-1][0] if stack else ""
            if inner == "[":"
client/src/components/reference_panel.gleam:1053-1055:
"            event.on_click(msg.UserChoseRefcheckAction(
              call.reference_call_id,
              RefcheckSubstitute,
            )),"
detail: The construction at reference_panel.gleam:1053 sits inside `UserChoseRefcheckAction(...)` call parens, so `inner == "["` is False and the token is exempt by shape. Only `view_substitute_entry`'s hook gate (line 1029) plus panel tests guard this site — the CI lint cannot see it.
recommended_fix: Extend the lint to flag `UserChoseRefcheckAction(..., RefcheckTakeOver|RefcheckSubstitute)` constructions whose enclosing function lacks a matching `case call.hooks.can_*` gate, or move construction below the gate.

title: W2 fix silently flips trigger slot-liveness for unrecognised status strings — now inconsistent with idx_reference_call_live and unpinned by any test
evidence:
server/src/reference_checks/trigger.gleam:1157-1158:
"fn is_terminal(status: String) -> Bool {
  is_terminal_status(status_from_string(status))
}"
shared/src/shared/reference_call.gleam:139:
"    _ -> Failed"
server/src/reference_checks/trigger.gleam:1103-1105:
"/// The first live (non-terminal) row for the slot, if any. Terminal statuses
/// match `idx_reference_call_live`'s exclusion list — a terminal row does not
/// occupy the slot. Exported for the RC4.3 substitute path's successor read."
supabase/migrations/20260731222000_create_reference_call.sql:138-140:
"CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_reference_call_live
  ON reference_call(application_id, ref_slot, owner_label)
  WHERE status NOT IN ('form_completed','unreachable','refused','objected','manual_recorded','failed','completed','partial');"
detail: Pre-fix `list.contains([8 strings], status)` returned False for unknown values — slot occupied, feeding trigger.gleam:697-700's 'v2 voice state' branch. Post-fix, the `_ -> Failed` fallback makes unknown terminal, so `find_live_row_for_slot` reports the slot free while the unique index still treats the row as live; the insert attempt then 409s. Zero test coverage.
recommended_fix: Pin trigger.is_terminal's unknown-status branch (treat unrecognised as live to match the index, or document + test the terminal choice) and add a unit test asserting agreement with the index exclusion list.

title: Lockstep direction 2 hardcodes the 14-string status universe — a new terminal status missed from the production const escapes the test
detail: Direction 1 iterates the exported const, but direction 2 enumerates a test-local 14-string copy. A 15th terminal status added to `is_terminal_status` (truth-table forces the case update) yet omitted from `terminal_statuses` is never checked, because its string is absent from the hardcoded list — the B1 mirror-drift class recurs in direction 2.
recommended_fix: Export the status-string universe from shared (e.g. `all_status_strings`) and iterate it in direction 2, so new enum values are covered without a test-side copy.

title: Rewritten hooks lint only flags list-position constructions — binding or helper-returning construction escapes (sandbox-verified)
evidence:
scripts/lint_refcheck_hooks.py:17-19:
"Detection is token-based (comments/strings stripped), so construction shape
is irrelevant: single-line (`[RefcheckTakeOver]`), multiline, or non-final
list position (`[RefcheckTakeOver, RefcheckSubstitute]`) are all caught"
scripts/lint_refcheck_hooks.py:134-139:
"            inner = stack[-1][0] if stack else ""
            if inner == "[":
                # list construction: must have an enclosing gate of the
                # matching hook name at ANY depth
                wanted = HOOK_FOR[tok]
                if not any(b == "{" and g == wanted for (b, _, g) in stack):"
detail: Sandbox run: `let a = RefcheckTakeOver` then `case call.status { unreachable -> [a] }` exits 0; `fn helper() { RefcheckTakeOver }` exits 0. The r1 multiline/non-final evasions are caught, but bound or helper-returned constructions never match `inner == "["` — the docstring's 'shape is irrelevant' claim overstates reach.
recommended_fix: Also flag bare `RefcheckTakeOver`/`RefcheckSubstitute` tokens in `let` bindings and fn return position unless enclosed by the matching hook gate, or narrow the docstring claim.
